name: logistics-experience-template
description: White-label premium website template for transport & logistics companies (Astro + GSAP + Three.js).

scripts.build:all: for c in ortiva nordhaven ferrum meridian; do CLIENT=$c astro build --outDir dist-$c || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check:links && npm run test:e2e
scripts.render:assets: STUDIO=1 astro build && echo 'Now serve dist and run: node scripts/render-assets.mjs http://localhost:4321'
